reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent: actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and naiwa.png reference; inspected native raw regions and verified evidence, source, output, prompt, task, request, result and sheet SHA-256/metadata bindings with read-only Python.

entries.positive_observation: The raw otherwise preserves the compact yellow mascot identity, green-ringed solid black eyes without sclera, dark brows, clean-shaven chin, one stern closed mouth and viewer-right three-quarter pose/gaze. The olive cap retains gold piping/braid, glossy black visor and two separated front insignia elements. The red standing collar has gold-embroidered red tabs with the viewer-right tab partly note-occluded, and fits a short broad neck without a long column, pinching or floating cloth. The dark backplate, two compact note rows, largely blank lower note and small dark mid-right note tab are present, with no visible interior alpha hole or lost backing.
entries.alpha_decision: visible-alpha-v1: reject for the cap/frame exterior mismatch, not for near-opacity. Internal 252-254 values are acceptable and no visible interior holes or lost backing occur, but the cap covers the source frame's upper rail and the returned top alpha contour becomes a cap-influenced flattened plateau instead of retaining the source's straight sloping frame top. The RGB cap/frame placement and corresponding exterior silhouette still require correction; this is not an alpha-only repair candidate.
visible_limitations: Fine cap and collar insignia motifs and note glyphs are unreadable at 65x67; only visible shapes, placement and counts were assessed, and these unresolved fine details are not rejection grounds.
The source hairline and sideburns are covered by the cap; no covered-hair claim is made beyond the visible dark brows and clean-shaven face.
remaining_reasons: Restore the source's tight cap placement and complete upper photographic frame. In the native attempt 04 crop, the cap crown still overlaps and covers the upper frame rail; the return-alpha top edge also has a cap-influenced flattened bulge/plateau rather than the source's straight sloping frame silhouette. Move/resize the cap within the original frame crop and restore the continuous rail and frame-shaped exterior while retaining the corrected viewer-right pose, two note rows and small mid-right note tab.
